01-plant-explorer.webp.caption: Plant Explorer
01-plant-explorer.webp.alt: Plant Explorer, an Angular app that browses the Trefle botanical database: page buttons above a grid of plant cards with photos, common names and Latin names.

02-page-two.webp.caption: Page two of results
02-page-two.webp.alt: Plant Explorer showing the second page of plants: a green header, page buttons, and a grid of plant photo cards including Evergreen Oak, Common Nettle, Barnyard Grass, Narrow-Leaf Plantain, Milfoil, Dutch Clover, Yorkshire-Fog and Creeping Buttercup.

03-last-page.webp.caption: Last page
03-last-page.webp.alt: Plant Explorer on its last page of results, with the Next button greyed out above cards for Elder, Purple Moor Grass, Sycamore Maple, Black Thistle, Cinquefoil, Cow-Parsley, Mountain Geranium and Smooth Meadow Grass.
